description: This file defines the Service class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It models a web service API, offering methods to retrieve service metadata, operations, error shapes, paginators, waiters, and protocol-specific serializers and parsers. It serves as a core component for interacting with AWS services programmatically.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a web service API model, providing access to service metadata, operations, error shapes, protocol-specific serializers/parsers, paginators, and waiters within the AWS SDK.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Service object with a definition array and an API provider callback, setting up service metadata, operations, shapes, and context parameters.

methods.name: createSerializer
methods.description: Creates a request serializer for a given API service and endpoint based on the protocol specified in the service definition.

methods.name: createErrorParser
methods.description: Creates an error parser function for the specified protocol, optionally associated with a specific service.

methods.name: createParser
methods.description: Creates a response parser for the API service based on its protocol.

methods.name: getServiceFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the service.

methods.name: getServiceId
methods.description: Returns the service ID.

methods.name: getApiVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the API version string of the service.

methods.name: getEndpointPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves the endpoint prefix used by the service.

methods.name: getSigningName
methods.description: Retrieves the signing name used by the service, falling back to endpoint prefix if not set.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the service name, if available in the metadata.

methods.name: getSignatureVersion
methods.description: Returns the signature version used by the service, defaulting to 'v4' if not specified.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol used by the service (e.g., json, query).

methods.name: getUid
methods.description: Returns the UID string used by the service.

methods.name: hasOperation
methods.description: Checks if a specific operation exists in the service definition by name.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Retrieves an operation object by name, creating it if it does not exist or if the model has been modified.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Returns all operations of the service as an array.

methods.name: getErrorShapes
methods.description: Retrieves all exception shape definitions associated with the service.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves all service metadata or a specific key value if provided.

methods.name: getPaginators
methods.description: Returns the available paginator configurations for the service.

methods.name: hasPaginator
methods.description: Checks if a paginator exists by name.

methods.name: getPaginatorConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for a specific paginator by name.

methods.name: getWaiters
methods.description: Returns the available waiter configurations.

methods.name: hasWaiter
methods.description: Checks if a waiter exists by name.

methods.name: getWaiterConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for a specific waiter.

methods.name: getShapeMap
methods.description: Returns the shape map used by the API.

methods.name: getClientContextParams
methods.description: Returns the context parameters for the client.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the API provider callback.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the service definition array.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets the service definition array and updates internal shape map; internal use only.

methods.name: isModifiedModel
methods.description: Indicates whether the service definition has been modified.
